name: Public Health: Causes of Death
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Department.Publishing Department: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Section
columns.description: Umbrella category of cause of death

columns.name: Sub Section
columns.description: Specific cause of death, classified according to associated ICD-10 code. Full code mapping is provided in the attached document.

columns.name: Place
columns.description: Municipality or area the death took place. CCDPH jurisdiction refers to all Cook County municipalities except Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park, Forest View, Burbank, and (incorporated) Stickney. See the attached district map for more information.

columns.name: Age Group
columns.description: Age group of decedent at the time of death

columns.name: Race/Ethnicity
columns.description: Race and ethnicity of decedent. "NH" refers to "non-Hispanic".

columns.name: Count
columns.description: Total number of deaths for the given population and time period

columns.name: Crude Mortality Rate
columns.description: Number of deaths for a population by a specific cause during a specified time period, per 100,000 people

columns.name: Age-Adjusted Mortality Rate
columns.description: Mortality rate for a population adjusted for age distribution. Calculated as a weighted average of age-specific death rates, using the U.S. 2000 Standard Population to determine age-group weights
